def choose_move(observation):
    resources = observation.get('resources', [])
    enemies = observation.get('enemies', [])
    allies = observation.get('allies', [])
    territory = observation.get('territory', [])
    position = observation.get('position', (0, 0))
    grid_width = observation.get('grid_width', 10)
    grid_height = observation.get('grid_height', 10)
    
    x, y = position
    
    # Set default target to center of grid
    target_x, target_y = grid_width / 2, grid_height / 2
    
    # Priority: resource_collection, pursuit_evasion, territory_control
    # Check for resources
    if resources:
        target = min(resources, key=lambda p: abs(p[0] - x) + abs(p[1] - y))
        tx, ty = target
    # Else check for enemies
    elif enemies:
        target = min(enemies, key=lambda p: abs(p[0] - x) + abs(p[1] - y))
        tx, ty = target
    # Else check territorial positions
    elif territory:
        try:
            # Defensive: use get in case territory is None or not list
            territory_list = territory if isinstance(territory, list) else []
            if territory_list:
                sx = sum(pos[0] for pos in territory_list) / len(territory_list)
                sy = sum(pos[1] for pos in territory_list) / len(territory_list)
                tx, ty = sx, sy
            else:
                tx, ty = target_x, target_y
        except:
            tx, ty = target_x, target_y
    else:
        tx, ty = target_x, target_y
    
    # Decide movement towards target
    dx = dy = 0
    if tx > x:
        dx = 1
    elif tx < x:
        dx = -1
    if ty > y:
        dy = 1
    elif ty < y:
        dy = -1
    
    # Constrain moves to -1..1
    if dx not in (-1,0,1):
        dx = 0
    if dy not in (-1,0,1):
        dy = 0
    
    return [dx, dy]
